hooks.name: Sync Translations

action.prompt:
The primary English locale file was just edited. Please:

1. Identify new or modified keys. For src/locale/en.json run `node scripts/i18n.mjs missing` (and compare changed English values via git diff) instead of reading the 1800-line files by hand.
2. For each new or changed key, generate accurate translations for ALL 12 target languages: German (de), Spanish (es), French (fr), Italian (it), Japanese (ja), Korean (ko), Polish (pl), Portuguese (pt), Russian (ru), Turkish (tr), Chinese Simplified (zh-CN), Chinese Traditional (zh-TW).
3. If the edited file was `src/locale/en.json`: write the translations as one payload and apply them with `node scripts/i18n.mjs apply payload.json` (it inserts keys next to their English siblings), then delete the payload file and confirm `node scripts/i18n.mjs check` reports every locale complete.
4. If the edited file was `public/_locales/en/messages.json`, update the same keys in public/_locales/<locale>/messages.json for de, es, fr, it, ja, ko, pl, pt, ru, tr, zh_CN, zh_TW, keeping the English key order. Keep the English `description` field.
5. Preserve existing translations for unchanged keys — only add or update what changed.
6. Never translate product names: Better Sidebar, Web Agent, Web Agent Connector, Power Pack, Gemini, AI Studio, Paper Crane Dev.
7. Plurals (`_one` / `_other` keys): give each language the variants it really needs. zh/ja/ko/tr use the same text for every variant. de/es/fr/it/pt need correct singular and plural. Russian keeps full `_few`/`_many` forms. For Polish (and any other language with complex plural rules) do not add `_few`/`_many`; instead phrase the base key, `_one` and `_other` count-neutrally, e.g. "Wykonane kroki: {{count}}" — i18next falls back to the base key.
8. Respect locale-specific conventions (formal Sie in German, vous in French, honorifics in Japanese, simplified vs traditional Chinese characters).
9. Keep placeholder variables (like {{name}}, $1, etc.) untranslated in the output.

hooks.description: When the primary English locale files (src/locale/en.json or public/_locales/en/messages.json) are edited, identifies new or modified text keys and generates translations for all 12 target languages. Maintains proper context, meaning, and locale-specific conventions.
